repos_data.description: The world's most flexible commerce platform for agents and developers
A powerful MCP toolkit for coding, providing semantic retrieval and editing capabilities  - the IDE for your agent
Free, local tool to track AI coding token usage and cost across 37 tools and agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and more), by model, project, and task. npx codeburn

LeanCTX is the Context Gateway for AI Systems. Select task-relevant context, apply supported controls, connect local knowledge and inspect recorded evidence. Open-source Engine: CLI, MCP, hooks and supported proxy paths.

OpenBitFun combines a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust with a polished desktop application. It pairs the depth of a Code Agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development.
Manage multiple Claude Code, OpenCode agents from either TUI or Web for easy access on mobile. Also supports Mistral Vibe, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Pi.dev, Copilot CLI, Factory Droid Coding.
A realtime voice runtime that keeps Agents talking, working, and present.  Real-time Voice Runtime for AI Agents
An open coding agent for your terminal, built by a community collective rather than a company. Bring your own model, keep your code on your machine, and owe nothing to anyone.
Plan, build and review software with your coding agents. Work side by side in the App or browser, or use your favourite terminal or IDE.
Agentic development harness for Claude Code — SPEC-driven plan/run/sync, TRUST 5 quality gates, model+effort routing, and Claude×GLM multi-LLM cost control. Single Go binary, 16 languages, zero deps.
Shell and coding agent on mcp clients

mu (μ): most of what a coding agent decides isn't code. mu hands 40 kinds of yes/no calls to a small model: fewer wasted tokens, fewer approvals on autopilot, fewer runs that stop halfway. Built on pi.
CLI proxy that reduces LLM token usage by 60-90%. Declarative YAML filters for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini. rtk alternative in Go.

native macOS app that gives you a real-time dashboard for your Claude Code and Cowork sessions, with analytics, conversation history, security hardening, real time secrets detection and project insights.
Ultra-fast token & cost tracker for LLM Token Usage (e.g. Claude Code)
A keyboard-first menubar app to monitor and jump between AI coding sessions — minimum setup required.
Persistent memory for AI coding agents. Local-first, cross-session context, global knowledge, and optional autonomous task execution.
A lightweight, zero-footprint TypeScript MCP server that lets AI assistants drive the Godot 4.x game engine.
A context-aware terminal-based coding agent written in Go. Supports multiple-providers, MCPs, Subagents, Agent Skills, controllable tool output retention, hashline edits, and more.
Explicit YAML orchestration for AI-augmented Spring Boot REST — declare each endpoint's steps, order, and branches in one readable, generatable file.

Codebase Context gives AI agents understanding of your codebase through semantic code search, team conventions, patterns, and memory, so they use fewer tokens, spend less time, and produce better, more familiar output.
17 MCP query tools for codebase navigation — functions, classes, imports, dependency graphs, change impact. Zero dependencies. 87% token reduction.

See what your coding agent actually did. A desktop pal and notch for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and any agent: test results read from the output, faked passes caught, and an MCP server any AI tool can ask. New: talk to Blu, who sees your screen, draws on it as it explains and uses your apps.
Local-first MCP server that gives coding agents structured context packets, code/schema facts, and diagnostics - backed by a local SQLite store.
MCP Server for persistent code indexing. Gives AI assistants (Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor) instant access to your codebase. 50x less context than grep.
Extract domain knowledge from codebases to reduce LLM token consumption by 20x and time in agentic search by 10x — gathers and makes concepts, naming conventions, and vocabulary queryable via MCP.

Claude Code and Codex in your Mac menu bar: see which AI coding agent is working, waiting for you or running background tasks, get alerts before weekly and 5-hour usage limits run out, and add desktop widgets. Free, open source, native macOS.
Inverted code review: a read-first IDE where you comment on the lines that matter and your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot) resolves them. Free and open source.
Architectural drift prevention for the agentic AI SDLC.
Talk to your shell — commands run, questions go to AI. No prefixes.
AI agent for JetBrains IDEs: debugger, refactorings, and symbol navigation via IDE — fewer tokens, more precision
Persistent decision memory for AI agents: rationale, rejected approaches, and entity history. Connect any compatible agent through local MCP or the CLI.
MCP tool server for AI coding agents -- encoding-aware file tools, binary analysis, DAP debugger, SSH/SFTP, process memory, and more

world-model-mcp is a signed audit memory server for AI coding agents, delivered as an MCP tool. Every event Ed25519-signed and Merkle-chained; offline-verifiable against pinned public keys. Hosted platform with hybrid post-quantum signing at etch.systems.
Remote-control Unity Editor from any AI IDE — 62 tools including AI-powered profiling & light probes. File-based IPC, zero dependencies.

Dashboard + macOS menu bar for tracking AI subscription quotas in one place (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor). Supports multi-accounts, notifications, and session-timer start optimization.
Evidence-backed proof of done for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other AI coding agents. Run real checks, bind results to current Git state, and know what is ready for human review.
Run Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents in a local VM on a clone of your project, then review their changes like a pull request. Mac app, CLI for Linux and Windows.
Persistent AI memory with hybrid search and embedded sync. Open, free, unlimited.
VS Code × Codex × Jira, in one free, open-source Mac app. Repository browsing, Kanban tasks, subagent inspection and local code review. Public beta, macOS 15+.

Self-maintaining and persistent codebase memory for AI coding agents — a deterministic AST index plus agent-written notes that flag themselves stale when the code changes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via MCP + CLI.
Unified MCP server for AI-assisted iOS development — build, deploy, screenshot, and interact with iOS Simulator from Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client
The world's smallest coworker lives in your Mac's notch. Peek, a tiny 3D character, watches Claude Code and Codex so you don't have to. brew install --cask deepshal99/tap/notch-so-good
Open-source coordination engine for AI agents, over MCP. Atomic claims, shared ledger, leases, presence, handoffs, tasks. Self-host it or use the hosted service at llm-bus.com.
AI-coding pitfalls & best practices, written from the AI's first-person POV — 76 entries across 5 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Gemini). Fully bilingual 中文/English.

Free, 100% local MCP server. Turns your codebase into an AST knowledge graph so AI coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) get exact caller trees, semantic search, and safe writes — 60% fewer tokens, zero data egress.
MCP server for generating development plans, project roadmaps, and task breakdowns for Claude Code. Turn project ideas into paint-by-numbers implementation plans.
Local AgentOps for cross-vendor CLI coding agents: route work, recover state, and accept only with evidence.
MCP server that teaches any AI agent the AIDE spec methodology — progressive   disclosure specs alongside code
Local-first MCP server for shared memory, reservations, handoffs, and review evidence across AI coding agents.
Persistent, agent-agnostic session memory for AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, opencode). One Markdown vault, any agent.
Multiplayer for AI coding agents: collision detection before the edit, messaging, delegation. MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex.
tailtest for Cline: MCP server + .clinerules pack + Memory Bank integration. Reaches 8+ editors via Cline. Adversarial test mode shipped from day one.
AETumi MCP — install premium, production-ready Three.js/WebGL 3D web components into Claude Code, Cursor & Codex. Premium 3D web you own, from AETumi (aetumi.app).
Local-first code graph + context engine for AI coding agents (Rust/MCP server). Published in microsoft/winget-pkgs (winget install halloffame12.CTX) & awesome-mcp-servers. A+ on Glama.
Unified MCP server: hybrid search + code graph + semantic memory. 10 tools, <350MB RAM, fully local. No API keys.
Rollback and safety for AI coding agents and vibe coders: flag risky changes and restore project files, including uncommitted work, to their pre-session state.
Client intake for AI coding agents — MCP server: your agent asks the client for logos, copy and credentials, and BriefGate chases them until they arrive.
